roadmaps.name: Aether MVP — Persistent agents and a reproducible demonstration
roadmaps.description: Operator-agreed October 8 priority baseline: an agent completes meaningful work, returns with its experience intact and uses it well on the next project. MVP-00 is the module/repair prerequisite; MVP-01 through MVP-10 are the agreed product priorities. These are integration outcomes linked to existing delivery sprints, not duplicate implementation assignments. The public-safe, installable demonstration should substantiate Michel's AI engineering work. Current path and requirement tests: Projects/Aether/MVP_PATH.md and Projects/Aether/MVP_ACCEPTANCE_TEST.md. No deadline reinstated; future model advantage remains a hypothesis. The same-day agreed MOD-16 Agent Editor contract is also MVP scope: ADS-05 tracks prototype browser/demo acceptance and ADS-06 tracks production integration, Ultralight hiring and heavyweight consent/rehydration. These are linked delivery work, not an invented eleventh product priority.
roadmaps.owner: Michel: product authority, the design and final acceptance. Since the 10-30 Tasker Process: Praxis (heavyweight lane: Overseer, Librarian, native verification) and Opus 5.5 (lightweight lane: Tasker, Timer, staff; the GUI since 11-02). Earlier leads are in the log.
roadmaps.next: November 8: the latest deployable is praxis18 (build/windows-tasker-20261108-praxis18; offline checks and upgrade rehearsal passed; its Chat backend is byte-identical to praxis16, which passed a live DeepSeek check). Where the running copy, the deployable and the archived builds are: AETHER_LOCATIONS.md. Next: Michel's check of praxis18 here (F12 and L1 in the app); the live branch not yet seen (a failed answer followed by End); the homepage revamp for the company presentation (plan written 11-08, awaiting Michel); the acceptance protocol run. Held until after the MVP: Retire, and a closing turn after a stopped sprint.
